subject: SIG evidence: staging & verification runbook
messages:
From: Lisa Wong <lisa.wong@aurora-finance.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: security@aurora-finance.com
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: SIG evidence intake — request for staging & verification runbook

Hi Mateo / Kim,

Thanks again for the time on Tuesday. Our InfoSec team wants a concise playbook that explains how you stage SIG artifacts, perform provenance verification, and escalate any mismatches discovered during intake. Specifically:

- A short checklist of artifact preconditions (hashing, signatures, redaction state)
- Where and how artifacts are staged (S3 path, retention policy, access controls)
- Who performs the manual checks vs. automated checks and expected SLAs
- Evidence we can use in our audit (timestamped manifests, verifier logs)

Can you provide a runbook (PDF) and an index (spreadsheet) that maps SIG controls to the corresponding artifact sample we will review? We have an internal deadline of 2026-12-15 for the security review.

Attachment: sample template we prefer (headers only).

Appreciate a brief reply with estimated delivery and any blockers.

—Lisa Wong
Senior Security Manager, Aurora Finance
security@aurora-finance.com

---
From: mateo alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Wong <lisa.wong@aurora-finance.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence intake — request for staging & verification runbook

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear ask.

High-level: we can deliver a compact runbook + artifact index in two stages:
1) A minimal runbook (PDF) + index spreadsheet by 2026-12-07 for your initial review. This will cover staging paths, ACLs, hashing approach, and who owns each step.
2) A follow-up technical appendix with sample verifier logs and timestamped manifests by 2026-12-13.

Quick notes on scope / blockers:
- Redaction: We will provide redacted samples where data residency requires it. We will mark redacted fields in the index.
- KMS/Evidence: proof-of-possession includes KMS request ids and last-rotation timestamps; we can include examples but not raw keys (obviously).
- Automation: our ingestion pipeline generates an artifact manifest.json with sha256 and a signed manifest token — we'll include an example.

I attached the SIG-Artifact-Index.xlsx (draft) and runbook-digest-v1.0.pdf (skeleton). Kim and Mina, can you confirm the owner assignments (lines marked with TODO in the spreadsheet)?

Thanks,
Mateo
Senior Manager, Assurance Intake
Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: SIG-Artifact-Index.xlsx (spreadsheet), runbook-digest-v1.0.pdf (PDF)

---
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: Lisa Wong <lisa.wong@aurora-finance.com>, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 14:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence intake — request for staging & verification runbook

On Thu, Dec 3, 2026 at 11:05 AM mateo alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com> wrote:
> I attached the SIG-Artifact-Index.xlsx (draft) and runbook-digest-v1.0.pdf (skeleton).

Thanks — I reviewed the draft index. I filled in owner columns for:
- Control 3.1 (Key custody proof): Owner = Security Ops (Kim P.)
- Control 5.2 (Patch evidence): Owner = Infra Compliance (Mina H.)

Notes for intake runbook:
- Staging path: s3://redwood-evidence/aurora/<account-id>/staging/yyyy-mm-dd/
  ACL: cross-account read with short-lived role assumption; bucket policy enforced.
- Manifests: manifest.json includes file list, sha256, created_at, created_by, signer_id, signature (detached). We will include a sanitized example in the appendix.
- Verification SLA: automated checks within 15 minutes of ingest; manual review within 48 hours for flagged items.

Kim P. (internal) will be the point for key-provenance questions during the review call. Mina — can you confirm the retention and redaction guidance for Aurora's EU customers?

-Kim
Director, Assurance & Controls
Redwood Inference

---
From: mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Wong <lisa.wong@aurora-finance.com>, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 16:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence intake — request for staging & verification runbook

Lisa / team — confirming retention & redaction notes for inclusion:

- EU account artifacts: we will provide redacted copies for any PII fields; original unredacted artefacts will remain in a customer-specific, access-restricted bucket in the eu-west-1 region. Access will be granted to Aurora reviewers via short-lived presigned URLs and explicit IAM role assumption.
- Retention: staging area retains artifacts for 30 days by default; after acceptance into the evidence archive retention is configurable per contract (default 365 days). We will note the archival workflow and deletion proof (s3 object lifecycle + deletion marker + manifest entry).
- Audit proofs: we can provide a sample signed-manifest.log with verifier output (sha256 matches, signer_id present, timestamp) — this will be in the technical appendix.

Action items:
- Mateo: finalize the runbook PDF and index spreadsheet; remove TODOs and mark owners by EOD 2026-12-07.
- Kim: prepare a one-page key-provenance note for Control 3.1.
- Lisa: confirm whether presigned URL access meets your team's review policy or if you prefer temporary cross-account IAM roles.

I'll assemble the appendix samples after Mateo pushes the skeleton.

Best,
Mina H.
Security & Evidence Engineer
Redwood Inference
